title: OLEANDER Lighting Design Process v1.0 — Candidate
purpose: Develop daylight and electric-light environments as task, spatial, visual, control and maintenance systems tied to measurable/observable conditions rather than fixture styling or rendered brightness.
scope_in: controls, scenes, daylight response and user interaction
calculation, mockup, sample, aiming and commissioning readback
maintenance, replacement, post-occupancy tuning and change
scope_out: electrical system engineering approval or circuit protection design
universal illuminance/CCT/CRI/UGR or spectral thresholds detached from Current source
authority_position: Candidate R-E professional-domain process subordinate to OLEANDER Master Runtime, Current Knowledge Authority, Professional Domain Process Contract, Cross-Disciplinary Integration, project/jurisdiction/appointment authority and responsible Lighting Design professional. Current Architecture Map remains OPEN for Lighting Design until explicit promotion.
